newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada native groups to appeal Voisey's Bay ruling.
newsitem.headline: Canada native groups to appeal Voisey's Bay ruling.

text.p: Two Canadian aboriginal groups are appealing a Canadian court ruling which rejected their bid to stop two construction projects at Inco Ltd's massive Voisey's Bay nickel project last week.
The Labrador Inuit Association filed its notice of appeal in Newfoundland Appeal Court on Monday, the Canadian Press news agency said.
The Innu Nation will also file an appeal, president Katie Rich told the news agency.
Newfoundland's Supreme Court on Friday dismissed an application by the two groups to block construction of an airstrip and road at the site.
Inco officials were unavailable for comment on Monday.
Voisey's Bay, one of the world's biggest nickel-copper-cobalt deposits, is set to start producing concentrate in late 1999 and refined nickel by late 2000.
